issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Tines 3B
products.tagline: The secure environment for agents, apps, and automations
products.summaryZh: 面向代理、应用与自动化的安全环境
products.descriptionZh: Tines 3B 是您最重要的代理、应用和自动化流程的统一安全环境。随时随地借助 AI 构建。代码隔离运行，凭据始终受保护。您发布的所有内容均可从一个位置全面审计和监控。Tines 3B 以代码为先、AI 原生，旨在帮助您在不牺牲安全性的前提下快速推进。探索版现已推出，提供 3 个实时工作流，用户、空间和连接器数量不限。
products.description: Tines 3B is the single, secure environment for your most important agents, apps, and automation. Build with AI, from anywhere. Code runs isolated and credentials stay protected. Everything you ship is fully auditable and monitored from one place. Tines 3B is code-first and AI-native, built to help you move fast without compromising on security. Explore Edition is available today and gives you access to 3 live workflows with unlimited users, spaces, and connectors.

products.name: BetterClaw
products.tagline: Deploy AI Agent, 60 seconds & $0 forever
products.summaryZh: 部署AI智能体，60秒完成，永久免费
products.descriptionZh: BetterClaw是一个无代码平台，用于构建按计划自动运行的AI代理，无需你亲自操作。连接Gmail、Slack或Telegram后，你的代理可以分类收件箱、发送晨间简报，或监控你关注的内容。代理最初以“实习生”身份运行，在采取行动前会先征询意见。自带AI密钥，则完全免费。
products.description: BetterClaw is a no-code platform for building AI agents that run on a schedule without you. Connect Gmail, Slack, or Telegram, and your agent triages inbox, sends morning briefings, or monitors what you care about. Agents start as Interns that ask before acting. Bring your own AI key and it's genuinely $0.

products.name: Xirp
products.tagline: The agentic development environment built by Spotify
products.summaryZh: 由Spotify构建的智能体开发环境
products.descriptionZh: 具备制度记忆的智能体开发环境。Xirp连接您的服务、所有权、文档及架构决策，使每次会话都从真实上下文开始。由Spotify Portal提供技术支持。
products.description: The agentic development environment with institutional memory. Xirp connects to your services, ownership, docs, and architectural decisions so every session starts with real context. Powered by Spotify Portal.

products.name: Bullet
products.tagline: 30-60% faster than Claude Code and Codex
products.summaryZh: 比Claude Code和Codex快30-60%
products.descriptionZh: Bullet是一款为速度而生的编码代理。我们厌倦了在等待代理运行上耗费数小时。模型本身没问题，但围绕它们的循环太慢了。Bullet会根据每个提示自动选择正确的模型/推理级别，并行化搜索/读取/命令，并使用定向代码搜索，而不是嵌入整个代码库。可与你的Claude Code或Codex订阅、API密钥或设备端模型配合使用。在SWE-bench Verified上达到95.8%（前三名），每任务119秒。由耶鲁计算机科学毕业生打造，前AppLovin/Citadel成员。
products.description: Bullet is a coding agent built for speed. We got tired of burning hours waiting on agent runs. The models were fine, but the loops around them were slow. Bullet auto-picks the right model/reasoning level per prompt, parallelizes searches/reads/commands, and uses targeted code search instead of embedding your whole repo. Works with your Claude Code or Codex subscription, API keys, or an on-device model. 95.8% on SWE-bench Verified (top 3), 119s/task. Built by Yale CS grads, ex-AppLovin/Citadel.

products.name: bb
products.tagline: The IDE that builds itself
products.summaryZh: 自我构建的IDE
products.descriptionZh: bb是一个代理型编排器图形界面，与Codex应用类似，但它兼容任何提供商：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode等。bb的独特之处在于它能够自定义并扩展自身。bb中的几乎任何功能都可以通过一条提示来更改。请求一个任务追踪器，它就会出现。bb还会创建一个技能，教会你的所有代理如何使用它。与其等待你的代理工作区添加所需功能，不如直接提出请求。
products.description: bb is an agentic orchestrator GUI, not unlike the Codex app, but it works with any provider: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. What makes bb different is that it can customize and extend itself. Almost anything in bb can be changed with a single prompt. Ask for a task tracker, and one appears. bb also creates a skill that teaches all of your agents how to use it. Instead of waiting for your agentic workspace to add the feature you need, you can just ask for it.

products.name: Continuum
products.tagline: Remember what you know about the people you manage
products.summaryZh: 记住你对所管理人员的了解
products.descriptionZh: Continuum是一款面向管理者的私人Mac应用。你可以记录下对每位下属的看法，在1对1会议中标记观察所得，并让这些认知在记录中自然演变。没有评分，没有报告，所有数据都不会离开你的Mac。
products.description: Continuum is a private Mac app for managers. You write down what you believe about each person you lead, tag what you notice in your 1:1s, and let your read change on the record. No scores, no reports, nothing that leaves your Mac.

products.name: Vizard Agent
products.tagline: One AI agent for every kind of video
products.summaryZh: 一个AI代理，适用于各种视频
products.descriptionZh: Vizard Agent是一款通用型AI视频代理，旨在承担整个视频制作流程。无论是原始素材、现有视频、链接、脚本、图片，还是仅有一个想法，都可以作为起点。告诉它你想要制作的内容，它便会规划并执行从剪辑、生成到再利用、本地化及修订等中间环节。无需为每个步骤管理不同工具，你只需向一个代理提出期望成果，并与之协作直至视频完成。
products.description: Vizard Agent is a general AI video agent built to take on the whole video job. Start with raw footage, an existing video, a URL, a script, an image, or just an idea. Tell it what you want to make, and it figures out the work in between, from editing and generation to repurposing, localization, and revisions. Instead of managing a different tool for every step, you give one agent the outcome you want and work with it until the video is finished.

products.name: Product Analytics for Agents and Users
products.tagline: Optimize Agent Actions with User Behavior.
products.summaryZh: 利用用户行为优化代理操作。
products.descriptionZh: Kubit帮助产品工程师通过用户行为优化AI代理。将代理追踪直接关联到用户活动，清晰了解用户为何重新提示、流失或转化。随后，将这些洞察直接输入编码代理，构建真正留住用户的AI产品。通过OTel、CDP或自带数据仓库（BYOW）无缝集成，即刻开始使用。
products.description: Kubit helps product engineers optimize AI agents with user behavior. Connect agent traces directly to user activities to see exactly why users re-prompt, drop off, or convert. Then, feed those insights straight into your coding agent to build AI products that actually stick. Start instantly with seamless integrations via OTel, your CDP, or Bring Your Own Warehouse (BYOW).

products.name: Cerenovus
products.tagline: Proactively find the money your company is losing
products.summaryZh: 主动发现公司正在流失的资金
products.descriptionZh: 我们收集贵公司内部的信息（文档、通讯和数据库），梳理出公司的业务流程，以及这些流程中的瓶颈和低效环节。接着，我们确定如何解决问题（以及这些问题是否值得解决）。最后，我们提供带有引用来源、经人工核实的报告，列出具体可行的步骤，助您取得实际成效。
products.description: We ingest information from around your company (documents, communications and databases), and map out your company's workflows, along with the bottlenecks and inefficiencies within those workflows. Then, we figure out how to fix the problems (and whether their worth fixing). Then, we give you cited, human-verified reports outlining concrete, actionable steps you can take to see real results.

products.name: Octomind Cloud and Hub
products.tagline: One login, zero API keys — cloud agents + 27 models
products.summaryZh: 一次登录，零API密钥——云端代理+27种模型
products.descriptionZh: 在云端运行AI代理——选择一台机器，告诉它要做什么，然后合上笔记本电脑。会话可从任何设备恢复。按秒计费，内置21个模型，无需API密钥。在24/25项基准测试任务中成功解决——领先于Claude Code和Codex。
products.description: Run AI agents in the cloud — pick a machine, tell it what to do, close your laptop. Sessions resume from any device. Per-second billing, 21 models built in, no API keys. Solved 24/25 benchmark tasks — ahead of Claude Code and Codex.

products.name: Gitar
products.tagline: AI code review that fixes what it finds
products.summaryZh: AI代码审查，自动修复发现的问题
products.descriptionZh: Gitar 审查拉取请求，诊断 CI 失败，应用修复，并针对你的流水线验证更改。它还可以重试不稳定的测试，自动化审查工作流，并直接在 GitHub 或 GitLab 内操作。现已成为 Sonar 的一部分。
products.description: Gitar reviews pull requests, diagnoses CI failures, applies fixes, and validates the changes against your pipeline. It can also retry flaky tests, automate review workflows, and act directly inside GitHub or GitLab. Now part of Sonar.

products.name: agent-manager
products.tagline: The fastest workflow for developing with AI
products.summaryZh: 使用AI进行开发的最快工作流程
products.descriptionZh: 在一个tmux列表中运行Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、Grok和Pi，每个会话实时显示状态。space键无需附加即可回答被阻塞的代理，f键将对话分叉为命名兄弟会话，T键在代理旁固定一个普通shell，ctrl+r打开整个文件差异，行注释作为一条审查提示返回。会话可以生成到各自的git worktree中。普通tmux会话在退出管理器后仍然存在。单个Go二进制文件，Apache-2.0许可。支持macOS、Linux及通过WSL2运行的Windows。
products.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Grok and Pi in one tmux list with live status per session. space answers a blocked agent without attaching, f forks the conversation into a named sibling, T pins a plain shell next to the agents, and ctrl+r opens whole-file diffs where line comments go back as one review prompt. Sessions can spawn into their own git worktrees. Ordinary tmux sessions survive quitting the manager. One Go binary, Apache-2.0. macOS, Linux, Windows via WSL2.

products.name: VoiceGecko
products.tagline: Open source, local voice-to-text
products.summaryZh: 开源、本地语音转文字
products.descriptionZh: 桌面即时听写。按下快捷键，说话，即刻在剪贴板获得准确文本——适用于邮件、编程、AI提示或灵感速记。
products.description: Instant dictation for desktop. Press a shortcut, speak, and instantly get accurate text on your clipboard—perfect for emails, coding, AI prompts, or brain dumps.

products.name: Gotcha
products.tagline: World's First AI Copilot for Android. You talk. It acts.
products.summaryZh: 全球首款安卓AI助手。你说话，它执行。
products.descriptionZh: 用自然语言控制你的安卓手机。Gotcha是一款免费、开源的设备端AI助手，拥有100多种原生设备工具、双重安全模式，并支持在任何应用中实时语音通话，由Samosa AIR（LLM、STT和TTS）驱动。
products.description: Control your Android phone using natural language. Gotcha is a free, open-source on-device AI copilot featuring 100+ native device tools, dual safety modes, and real-time voice calls over any app, powered by Samosa AIR (LLM, STT, and TTS).

products.name: Lexi
products.tagline: The operating system for legal work
products.summaryZh: 法律工作的操作系统
products.descriptionZh: Lexi是法律工作的操作系统。法律团队使用Lexi在一个平台上起草、审查、研究、整理案件知识并追踪每个案件，而律师则专注于判断、策略、咨询、辩护和客户。
products.description: Lexi is the operating system for legal work. Legal teams use Lexi to draft, review, research, organize matter knowledge, and track every matter in one place, while lawyers stay focused on judgment, strategy, counsel, advocacy, and clients.

products.name: AMP by CanyonTechs AI
products.tagline: AI agents that act. Automation that delivers.
products.summaryZh: AI智能体，即刻行动。自动化，交付成果。
products.descriptionZh: AMP自动监控生产日志，检测事件，并自动开启带修复的可审查PR——无需提示。修复率超过80%。已认证支持Java、Python、TypeScript、Node.js和Rust。无直接生产环境访问权限。人机协同。使用代码PH3MOFREE。
products.description: AMP autonomously monitors production logs, detects incidents, and opens a reviewable PR with the fix — no prompting needed. 80%+ fix rate. Certified for Java, Python, TypeScript, Node.js & Rust. No direct prod access. Human-in-the-loop. Use code PH3MOFREE.

products.name: Switchy for Mac
products.tagline: Switch your Magic Keyboard, Trackpad, and Mouse between Macs
products.summaryZh: 在Mac之间切换你的妙控键盘、触控板和鼠标。
products.descriptionZh: Switchy是一款macOS菜单栏应用，能自动发现本地网络中的邻近Mac，让你无需断开重连或使用线缆，即可连接至你的魔法设备。对于拥有多台Mac或MacBook（如工作与个人设备）但希望使用一套魔法配件的用户来说，它非常实用。
products.description: Switchy is a macOS menu bar app that automatically discovers nearby Macs on your local network, so you can connect to your magic devices without disconnecting and reconnecting or having to use a cable. It's useful for users who have multiple Macs or MacBooks (i.e work and personal) but want to use one set of magic accessories.

products.name: ScreenMark
products.tagline: Menu bar app for live annotations, whiteboard overlay + more
products.summaryZh: 菜单栏应用，用于实时标注、白板覆盖及更多功能。
products.descriptionZh: ScreenMark是一款macOS菜单栏应用，用于实时屏幕标注、缩放、白板覆盖、画面冻结和录制。适合教师、演示者和开发者。配套的免费iPhone应用可将手机变为遥控器：触发光标高亮、手电筒、绘图和缩放。免费版涵盖核心标注工具。ScreenMark Pro解锁录制、实时缩放、光标高亮和手电筒、高级标注、自定义休息模式及自定义快捷键。
products.description: ScreenMark is a macOS menu bar app for live screen annotation, zoom, whiteboard overlay, freeze frame, and recording. Perfect for teachers, presenters, and developers. A free companion iPhone app turns your phone into a remote: trigger cursor highlight, flashlight, drawing and zoom. The free tier covers the core annotation tools. ScreenMark Pro unlocks recording, live zoom, cursor highlight and flashlight, advanced annotation, custom break-mode, custom shortcuts available in pro.

products.name: AdmitRaven
products.tagline: Duolingo for college applications
products.summaryZh: 大学申请版的Duolingo
products.descriptionZh: AdmitRaven是一款装在口袋里的大学升学顾问，成本仅为传统顾问的一小部分。它通过每日小课程，引导学生走完整个申请流程，并在完成课程前阻止无意义刷屏。它帮助学生撰写真实、有说服力的文书，确保不错过任何截止日期和要求，并匹配到合适的学校和奖学金。你甚至可以阅读梦想学校已录取学生的真实文书，并直接向他们提问。
products.description: AdmitRaven is a college counselor in your pocket for a fraction of the cost. It walks students through the entire application journey in daily, bite-sized lessons, and blocks doomscrolling until you finish them. It helps you craft authentic, compelling essays, stay on top of every deadline and requirement, and match to the right schools and scholarships. You can even read real admitted students' essays from your dream school, and ask them questions directly.

products.name: Equitybee Benchmark
products.tagline: Compare your startup equity grant for free.
products.summaryZh: 免费比较你的初创公司股权授予方案。
products.descriptionZh: Equitybee Benchmark帮助美国初创企业员工了解其股权授予的对比情况。探索超过2500家初创企业中9000多份经核实的入职授予，按部门、资历和公司阶段分类。多年来，企业一直在对标其提供的股权。现在，你也可以对标自己的股权。——该基准基于Equitybee的数据集提供市场背景，仅供参考。数据集未经独立核实。数据按原样呈现。
products.description: Equitybee Benchmark helps U.S. startup employees understand how their equity grants compare. Explore 9,000+ verified new-hire grants across 2,500+ startups by department, seniority, and company stage. For years, companies have benchmarked the equity they offer. Now you can benchmark yours. -- The benchmark provides market context based on Equitybee's dataset and is intended for informational purposes only. The dataset has not been independently verified. Data presented as is.
